nameSource.note: Every first name is a real given name taken from Wikidata (CC0): given-name items with an Arabic spelling, borne by people from Arab League countries. Each one was checked by hand, written in one simple English spelling and kept with its Arabic spelling. European names and names tied to one notorious person were left out. Names with ibn, bint, Abu or Umm are new combinations of those real names, and any that match a well-known person on Wikipedia, including the Prophet's family, were removed. No meanings are shown, because a meaning is only worth giving when it is certain.
